incidents.title: Direct SSH Login into DHCP Server
incidents.notes: An external Device (leased IP 10.0.0.10) was found to have the root access to DHCP/DNS Server. The resulting Machine was compromised and Zone Files were exfiltrated. The Machine needs a clean wipe.

rules.name: Netcat Reverse Shell Execution
rules.title: Netcat Reverse Shell Execution
rules.description: Detects interactive shell execution spawned via netcat or ncat
rules.yaml:
id: rule-reverse-shell
title: Netcat Reverse Shell Execution
description: Detects interactive shell execution spawned via netcat or ncat
severity: CRITICAL
status: production
detection:
  selection_cmd:
    type: COMMAND_EXECUTED
    command|contains:
      - "nc "
      - "netcat"
      - "ncat"
    command|contains_all:
      - "-e"
  selection_netcat_sh:
    command|contains:
      - "nc -e"
      - "netcat -e"
      - "/bin/bash"
      - "/bin/sh"
  condition: selection_cmd or selection_netcat_sh

rules.name: ARP Poisoning / Spoofing Activity
rules.title: ARP Poisoning / Spoofing Activity
rules.description: Detects execution of ARP spoofing tools or IP-MAC cache conflicts
rules.yaml:
id: rule-arp-spoof
title: ARP Poisoning / Spoofing Activity
description: Detects execution of ARP spoofing tools or IP-MAC cache conflicts
severity: CRITICAL
status: production
detection:
  selection_tool:
    type: COMMAND_EXECUTED
    command|contains:
      - "arpspoof"
      - "ettercap"
      - "bettercap"
  selection_cache_conflict:
    type: ARP_REPLY
    metadata.conflict: true
  condition: selection_tool or selection_cache_conflict

rules.name: Network Port Scanning
rules.title: Network Port Scanning
rules.description: Detects network port scanning tools (nmap) or rapid multi-port probes
rules.yaml:
id: rule-port-scan
title: Network Port Scanning
description: Detects network port scanning tools (nmap) or rapid multi-port probes
severity: HIGH
status: production
detection:
  selection_tool:
    type: COMMAND_EXECUTED
    command|contains:
      - "nmap"
  selection_probes:
    protocol:
      - TCP
      - SYN
  filter_dns:
    metadata.payload|contains: "dns_health"
  aggregation:
    field: dest_port
    distinct: true
    operator: ">="
    threshold: 4
    timeframe: 15s
    by: source
  condition: selection_tool or (selection_probes and not filter_dns)

rules.name: ICMP Reconnaissance Sweep
rules.title: ICMP Reconnaissance Sweep
rules.description: Detects ICMP ping sweep targeting 4 or more distinct destinations within 15 seconds
rules.yaml:
id: rule-icmp-sweep
title: ICMP Reconnaissance Sweep
description: Detects ICMP ping sweep targeting 4 or more distinct destinations within 15 seconds
severity: MEDIUM
status: production
detection:
  selection_icmp:
    protocol: ICMP
  filter_dns_health:
    metadata.payload|contains: "dns_health"
  aggregation:
    field: destination
    distinct: true
    operator: ">="
    threshold: 4
    timeframe: 15s
    by: source
  condition: selection_icmp and not filter_dns_health

rules.name: SSH Brute Force Attack
rules.title: SSH Brute Force Attack
rules.description: 3 or more SSH authentication failures from the same source within 60 seconds
rules.yaml:
id: rule-ssh-brute-force
title: SSH Brute Force Attack
description: 3 or more SSH authentication failures from the same source within 60 seconds
severity: CRITICAL
status: production
detection:
  selection:
    type: SSH_AUTH_FAILED
  aggregation:
    operator: ">="
    threshold: 3
    timeframe: 60s
    by: source
  condition: selection

rules.name: Direct Root Login / Privilege Escalation
rules.title: Direct Root Login / Privilege Escalation
rules.description: Direct root user interactive session or superuser privilege escalation detected
rules.yaml:
id: rule-root-login
title: Direct Root Login / Privilege Escalation
description: Direct root user interactive session or superuser privilege escalation detected
severity: CRITICAL
status: production
detection:
  selection_su:
    type: COMMAND_EXECUTED
    command|contains:
      - "sudo su"
      - "sudo -i"
      - "su -"
      - "su root"
  selection_ssh_root:
    type: SSH_AUTH_SUCCESS
    metadata.user: root
  selection_root_event:
    type: ROOT_LOGIN
  condition: selection_su or selection_ssh_root or selection_root_event

rules.name: SSH Interactive Login
rules.title: SSH Interactive Login
rules.description: Successful remote SSH authentication and interactive session opened
rules.yaml:
id: rule-ssh-success
title: SSH Interactive Login
description: Successful remote SSH authentication and interactive session opened
severity: LOW
status: production
detection:
  selection:
    type: SSH_AUTH_SUCCESS
  condition: selection

rules.name: SSH Interactive Login ROOT
rules.title: SSH Interactive Login ROOT
rules.description: Successful remote root SSH authentication and interactive session opened
rules.yaml:
id: rule-ssh-root-success
title: SSH Interactive Login ROOT
description: Successful remote root SSH authentication and interactive session opened
severity: CRITICAL
status: production
detection:
